stories.title: BMC starts demolition of building linked to Dawood Ibrahim in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Thursday (November 19, 2026) began pulling down a dilapidated building in south Mumbai, which was once the residence and an early base of fugitive gangster and 1993 serial blasts mastermind Dawood Ibrahim, officials said. stories.title: IIT-Bombay alumnus takes charge as Western Railway's new spokesperson

Meena, a 2014-batch Indian Railway Traffic Service (IRTS) officer, took charge as Western Railway's new Chief Public Relations Officer (CPRO) on Thursday, marking a shift from managing railway operations to handling the public communication of one of Mumbai's busiest suburban railway networks.

stories.title: Bal Thackeray photo row: Sena (UBT) workers demand FIR against Shaina NC

stories.title: Saif Ali Khan gets death threat from accused in Baba Siddiqui's murder case: Report

stories.title: BMC to raze ancestral home of Dawood Ibrahim
stories.summary: Haji Ismail Haji Habib Musafirkhana, a building on Pakmodia Street in Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar and widely known as the ancestral home of Dawood Ibrahim, is being demolished by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC). stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) launched a demolition drive at the dilapidated Musafirkhana building in Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar. stories.title: Mumbai housing societies to get 15% property tax rebate for efficient waste management
stories.summary: The BMC has announced a property tax incentive of up to 15% for residential housing societies that comply with prescribed waste management norms, including processing wet waste on their premises, managing dry waste and adopting water conservation measures. The incentives form part of a wider push by the BMC to enforce four-way waste segregation across Mumbai (wet, dry, sanitary and special care or environmentally harmful waste).

stories.title: Mumbai: Retired Army man stabbed in chest after intervening in son's altercation

stories.title: ‘I waived tax on ₹12 lakh income bracket. Did you hike salaries?’ PM Modi asks industries

stories.title: AQI worsens, city sees lowest temp of season | Latest News Delhi

stories.title: US prosecutor declines charges against white cop who killed Black man
stories.summary: Dane County district attorney Ismael Ozanne said officer Kiel Baitinger-Peterson acted reasonably when he shot Corey Ruiz on July 22. Ozanne said the circumstances left the officer with no reasonable alternative and that there was no potential criminal liability. He said his decision followed a review of police reports, diagrams, surveillance footage, squad car videos and recordings made by members of the public.

The network will comprise three 400 kV double-circuit transmission lines linking Pirpainti with Jhanjharpur and Begusarai, and Begusarai with Bakhtiyarpur.

stories.title: Sony WH-CH730N, WH-CH530 Wireless Headphones Launched in India: Price, Specifications
stories.summary: Sony has launched two new wireless headphones in India, the WH-CH730N and WH-CH530. The noise-cancelling WH-CH730N is priced at Rs 12,990, while the WH-CH530 costs Rs 4,490. stories.summary: Schools and other educational institutions in several districts of Odisha will remain closed on Friday, November 20, as the state braces for the impact of severe cyclonic storm Akvan. stories.title: CBI secures deportation of murder accused wanted by Kerala Police from UAE
stories.summary: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI), in coordination with the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA), the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and the Kerala Police, has secured the deportation of Raghesh Unnikochan, against whom a Red Notice had been issued, from the United Arab Emirates (UAE) on Wednesday.

stories.title: Bhopal Police Station Hit By Ransomware Attack, MP-CERT Recovers Encrypted Data Without Hackers' Help
stories.summary: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): The Madhya Pradesh Computer Emergency Response Team (MP-CERT) has successfully decrypted and recovered crucial data from a computer at Ayodhya Nagar police station in Bhopal following a ransomware attack. stories.summary: Larry Poindexter passed away at the age of 66 following an accident where he was hit by a car. He suffered significant injuries and was set to undergo surgery but died unexpectedly. Poindexter had a distinguished career spanning over four decades in television and film. He recently worked on an independent series titled 'Residual,' which remains his last project.

stories.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
stories.summary: Myanmar has been found guilty of committing genocide against its Rohingya minority by the International Court of Justice (ICJ). The verdict marks the first time a state has ever been found to have committed genocide by an international court. Yuji Iwasawa, president of the UN's top court, said Myanmar had the "intention to destroy" a substantial part of the Rohingya population and engaged in "extensive destruction of evidence" to hide its crimes.

stories.title: Senate rejects resolution to block Trump from striking Iran
stories.summary: Senate Republicans have blocked another effort to limit President Donald Trump’s military actions in Iran , voting against a resolution that would have directed him to end the conflict.
